page.title: Agentpost — Email for your AI agents
page.description: Give every AI agent its own email address. Create inboxes, receive mail, and reply with attachments using CLI, MCP, or API. Open source and self-hosted on Cloudflare.
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.title: Email for your agents.
hero.description: Give every agent an address. Let it read incoming mail, send the finished work, and keep the conversation going.
hero.note: Your domain. Your Cloudflare account. CLI, MCP, and API included.
workflow.title: One address. A complete workflow.
workflow.label: Email workflow steps
workflow.caption: Choose a step to explore. These are sample addresses and messages; the commands run against your own deployment.
create.title: Create an address
create.description: A random name, or one you choose. One inbox for each task.
receive.title: Read incoming mail
receive.description: Get the message, its attachments, and the original email.
reply.title: Reply with the work
reply.description: Send a report, image, or CSV. Keep the reply in its thread.
demo.title: Agent inbox
demo.subject: This week’s findings
demo.body: The source data is attached. Could you turn this into a short report?
demo.reply: Here is the summary, with the key findings and a chart.
demo.queueNote: Queued is a send state, not confirmation of delivery.
capabilities.title: A mailbox for every task.
capabilities.description: Useful email primitives, ready for the tools your agents already use.
feature1.title: Create addresses as you go.
feature1.description: Use a memorable name or generate a random address. Keep research, builds, and receipts in separate inboxes on your domain.
feature2.title: Send the finished work.
feature2.description: Attach PDFs, images, CSVs, and text files to sends and replies. Read incoming attachments and original MIME, too.
feature3.title: Pick up where you left off.
feature3.description: Watch for new messages with resumable events, or connect a signed inbox webhook. Save send keys to retry the same request safely.
hosting.title: Your domain. Your mail. Your control.
hosting.description: Deploy Agentpost in your own Cloudflare account, then connect your agents. Every operator runs their own instance.
hosting.diagramLabel: Agents connect through authenticated CLI, MCP or API to an Agentpost Cloudflare Worker, which stores mail and jobs in your own Cloudflare account.
hosting.domainDescription: Bring a Cloudflare-managed domain and route mail to the addresses you issue.
hosting.accessDescription: Use inbox tokens or Cloudflare Access OAuth, with ownership checks on each inbox.
hosting.retentionDescription: Original mail is retained first. Durable send state keeps ambiguous outcomes from becoming blind retries.
hosting.security: Read the security and verification notes
start.title: Give your next agent an inbox.
start.description: Install the client, deploy your instance, and connect the agent through the interface that fits your workflow.
start.clientNote: Node.js 22.14+ · Installing the client does not deploy the email service.
start.step1Description: Cloudflare DNS and a Workers Paid account are required.
start.step2Description: Configure storage, mail routing, sending, and authentication.
start.step3Description: Set the API URL and credentials, or use remote MCP OAuth.
beta: Cloudflare Email Sending is Beta. Before relying on an instance, verify its DNS, authentication, and real send/receive behavior. Email delivery is never guaranteed by a queued or accepted state.
footer.note: Open-source email infrastructure for AI agents.
